- NIMH communicates research findings to the public through press releases, social media, newsletters, and an annual research symposium.
- NIMH provides educational materials, videos, and webinars to make mental health information accessible to non-experts.

- NIMH supports research on environmental factors in mental illness development, including early childhood experiences and their interaction with genetic factors.
